SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: Artificial Analysis scores Muse Wonder 52 and Muse Wonder Full 56 on its Intelligence Index v4.3 at max effort, up from 48 for Muse Spark 1.3, released six weeks earlier.

SIGNALS.name: Meta for Developers
SIGNALS.summary: Muse Wonder is live in Muse Code and the Meta Model API, while Muse Wonder Full launches only for Muse Code subscribers. It combines coding, long-running agents and computer use.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta introduces Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable models yet, aimed at personal and professional agentic tasks; Muse Wonder is available now through the Meta Model API.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI Developers
SIGNALS.summary: Codex adds composer predictions in beta for Pro users: it suggests your next message based on the conversation and how you usually write.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Claude Docs, Slides and Design leave beta and become available on every plan including Free, with shared editing between a team and Claude.

SIGNALS.name: Sundar Pichai
SIGNALS.summary: At Gemini at Work, Google Cloud introduces a new Gemini agent: one universal work agent with business context for questions, knowledge work and more.

SIGNALS.name: DoT India
SIGNALS.summary: India's Department of Telecommunications says ITU's AI for Good initiative will be inaugurated in New Delhi on 9 October as part of IMC 2026.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 and Intelligent UI are rolling out in ChatGPT for everyone, giving more visual, interactive answers and on-the-spot tools for tasks.

SIGNALS.name: The Rundown AI
SIGNALS.summary: Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, is a 1T-parameter model that Mistral calls the strongest open model in the West; the post cites a 61.7% real-world coding score on DeepSWE.
